ownerWorkload.localSubstitutionReason: This actual-model case is explicitly ignored and invokes ci_only(), requiring genuine main-only GitHub Actions ARM64 execution. Setting CI variables in a local process would not supply the required run/source-bound acceptance identity. A separately named local diagnostic would remain local evidence and cannot bypass package admission.

Both PTQ1 owners reaped, then a third fresh owner explicitly chooses original PQ2 on the same runtime/adapter/worker policy and naturally completes the fixed answer.
Original absolute deadlines, 75-second rollback tail, 30-second owner cleanup reserves, 15-second post-cleanup full-file hash reserve and retained file/ancestor guards.

Pre-setup and post-retention aggregate power observations plus per-owner before/after AC/saver/charge observations; unknown remains unknown. Equal endpoint observations do not prove uninterrupted stability.
requiredBeforeExecution: Owner-reviewed exact-source hosted package and same-source Foundation acceptance.
Owner explicitly selects device execution and predeclares the supported ten-minute whole-job allowance with the fixed 450-second estimate and reason.
Setup, all arms, cleanup, hashing and retention share one original clock. Stop early if finished or infeasible; no retry, split matrix or reopening historical sessions.
